Container.Name: filearr-meilisearch
Container.Overview:
Meilisearch for filearr — typo-tolerant instant-search engine. The index is a DISPOSABLE projection: it can always be rebuilt from Postgres via filearr's rebuild task, so no backup is strictly required. Pinned to v1.53.1 (≥1.48.2 required for the CVE-2026-57823/57824 tenant-token fixes — do not run older versions or floating 'latest').
UPGRADING from an older pin: leave MEILI_UPGRADE_DB=true. A newer Meilisearch REFUSES to open an older database and the container will restart-loop without it; with it, the database is migrated in place on first start (verified 1.49.0 -> 1.53.0). It is a no-op once the database is current, so it is safe to leave on.
Install before the filearr container.
NETWORKING: two topologies are supported. DEFAULT — every container on one user-defined Docker network, addressing each other by NAME; create it once with docker network create filearr. ALTERNATIVE — every container fully bridged (Network Type: Custom br0) with its own fixed LAN IP, and IPs in place of names. Pick one before installing anything: https://pwsh.github.io/filearr/deployment/unraid/#step-0-networking

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Index data (LMDB, mmap-based). Use the DIRECT pool path (/mnt/cache/appdata/...) — mmap through the /mnt/user FUSE layer is unreliable, and search latency depends on the fast pool.

Config.Name: MEILI_MASTER_KEY
Config.Description: Master key (16+ chars) — must match FILEARR_MEILI_MASTER_KEY on the filearr container

Config.Name: MEILI_UPGRADE_DB
Config.Description: Migrate the index database in place when the pinned version moves forward. REQUIRED on a version bump: a newer engine refuses to open an older database and the container restart-loops without it. A no-op once the database matches the engine, so leave it on. The migration is not atomic — back up the appdata path before changing the pin.

Config.Name: MEILI_ENV
Config.Description: production hides the built-in preview UI; requires master key

Config.Name: Port (optional)
Config.Description: Only map for direct debugging of the search engine. Leave empty otherwise.
